receipt.public_excerpt: UN member states to build on existing international mechanisms and explore creating an international institution, able to set standards, enable verification, and convene states when capability thresholds are crossed.

evidence_items.explanation: The official text only asks states to 'explore' creating an institution. It sets out no funding, implementation plan, or governance structure, so how the call would be realized, financed, and governed was left open.

receipt.public_excerpt: The statement remains open for endorsement from leaders of other countries.

evidence_items.explanation: The statement is a non-binding joint call still open for more signatures, not a finished agreement with set arrangements.

receipt.public_excerpt: The United States and China, the world’s two leading AI powers, did not join the statement, which remains “open for endorsement” by other countries.

evidence_items.explanation: The leading AI powers stayed out, which adds to the open questions about how the call would be put into effect.

unresolved_gaps: 'Many questions' has no threshold, so the judgment rests on the plain reading that implementation, funding, and governance were unspecified.
